remarks: Bright and spacious 2-bedroom, 2-full-bath second-floor end-unit in Stamford's sought-after Chesterfield gated community. Tucked at the end of the building for added privacy and flooded with natural light from oversized windows and skylights, this home feels open and airy the moment you step inside. The inviting living room features dramatic vaulted ceilings, a cozy wood-burning fireplace, and direct access to your private deck - ideal for morning coffee or unwinding after a long day. A separate dining room flows seamlessly from the efficiently laid-out kitchen, creating the perfect setup for both daily living and entertaining.Both bedrooms are generously sized with excellent closet space, and the primary includes its own full bath. A rare pull-down attic offers exceptional storage you won't find in most condos.
